headline_marked: [[12 killed, 309 injured]] in Riyadh airport attack; 2 Bangladeshis among dead
headline: 12 killed, 309 injured in Riyadh airport attack; 2 Bangladeshis among dead
summary: An attack on Riyadh's international airport left 12 dead, including two Bangladeshis, and 309 wounded. Diplomatic sources attribute the strike to Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis, escalating regional tensions.
details: At least 12 people were killed and 309 others wounded in a strike on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport. Saudi Arabia's civil aviation officials confirmed the casualties, with some of the wounded in serious condition.

Among the deceased were two Bangladeshi citizens, four Saudi citizens, one US citizen, one Egyptian, one Jordanian, one Syrian, one Palestinian, and one Sudanese. This diverse casualty list highlights the international impact of the attack.

A diplomatic source attributed the attack to a missile from Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis. The Houthis have intensified strikes against Saudi Arabia since a UN-brokered truce in their long-running war with Yemen's Riyadh-backed government collapsed in July.

Operations at the sprawling King Khalid International Airport were suspended following the incident. Health officials activated a rare mass call-up of doctors to manage the "serious emergency situation."

One passenger described witnessing a strike in the airport's domestic terminal, stating, "I saw 401 hit, I saw injured in front of my eyes. Everyone was running." Foreign embassies also warned their citizens to avoid the airport.

Hours after the Riyadh attack, a "projectile" reportedly landed near King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, and a missile was intercepted southeast of the capital early Sunday. The Houthis had previously claimed strikes on Thursday that killed three people.

US President Donald Trump indicated that the US might consider joining Saudi strikes against the Houthis, stating, "We're going to look at it." Several Western embassies banned their staff from using the airport for the upcoming week.

The civil war in Yemen reignited in July, drawing Saudi Arabia deeper into the conflict. Analysts predict an even tougher stance from the Saudis, with one expert noting, "we are moving up the escalation ladder in a very dangerous way."

headline_marked: [[US gunman kills 8 relatives and family friend]] including pregnant woman, 2 children
headline: US gunman kills 8 relatives and family friend including pregnant woman, 2 children
summary: A 45-year-old man shot and killed his victims in Pennsylvania before taking his own life. The deceased included a woman eight months pregnant, a five-year-old boy, and a one-year-old girl.
details: A 45-year-old man shot and killed seven relatives and a family friend at a home in Pennsylvania before apparently taking his own life, authorities reported. The victims in the city of Erie included two young children and a woman who was eight months pregnant.

Police responded Friday evening to reports of shots fired and discovered two women dead in the street. Video evidence showed the pair arriving at the residence appearing distressed, then attempting to contact neighbors and enter the house.

The gunman exited the house, shot the two women, and then returned inside. He barricaded himself as police surrounded the building, and was later found inside with an apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound.
Dead inside the home were a five-year-old boy and a one-year-old girl. The other victims included men and women ranging in age from 19 to 51, with one woman being eight months pregnant.

Local officials expressed profound grief, with Erie Mayor Daria Devlin stating that many across the community are hurting. Counseling was offered to responding officers and first responders over the horrifying incident.
This incident highlights the frequent occurrence of mass shootings in the United States. Efforts to increase firearm restrictions in the country often face steep political and legal hurdles.
